name: Tyson Grilled & Ready Fully Cooked Frozen Chicken Breast Strips
whyItWorks: A lifesaving freezer staple for IBD patients with zero energy to cook: 100% real boneless, skinless chicken breast strips, flame-grilled and flash-frozen. Contains 0g breading, 0g fiber, under 2g fat, and heats in 90 seconds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Microwave 3 oz of strips for 60–90 seconds. Serve over warm white rice, stirred into chicken broth, or in a soft flour tortilla.
watchOuts: Completely unbreaded and lean; safe for acute flares, strictures, and remission.
